title: POST /storage_request: the request
description: The lab storage page's form, JSON, 8 KiB at most. A folder may be written with the root in front (then it must be inside the root), or as "." or the root itself for the whole volume; folders may also be one text with a folder a line. The service trims and lower-cases access_id and email; email must be exactly <access_id>@wayne.edu.

folders.description: one to eight folders under the root
